blocks.text: Zscaler offers multiple ways to capture network traffic. With Zscaler Traffic Capture Essentials, you can capture traffic as PCAP files, which can be accessed later through an Amazon S3 bucket managed by your organization, for supported actions with the following policies:

blocks.item: Advanced Threat Protection
File Type Control
Firewall Filtering
DNS Filtering
IPS Control
Malware Protection
URL Filtering

blocks.text: If your organization has Traffic Capture for Network Detection and Response (NDR), you can capture traffic as PCAPNG files with the Traffic Capture policy. To learn more, see About Traffic Capture Policy.
Traffic Capture Essentials provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Save time and effort by integrating Traffic Capture Essentials directly into Internet & SaaS (ZIA) policies.
Reduce the storage footprint of captured traffic data with granular control over sampling, the storage limit, and the type of traffic captured at the policy level.
Keep capture data secure and limited to those who have the necessary administrative privileges.
Limit exposure of personally identifiable information (PII) with information obfuscation.

blocks.heading: About the Traffic Capture Essential Page

blocks.text: On the Traffic Capture Essential settings tab (Internet Access > Traffic Capture > Settings > Traffic Capture Essential), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Edit the settings for Traffic Capture Essentials.
Enable Traffic Capture Essentials. To learn more, see Configuring Traffic Capture Essentials.
Connect or manage an Amazon S3 storage bucket. For the settings, you can see:
AWS Access ID: The ID associated with your connected S3 bucket.
AWS Secret Key: The password associated with your connected S3 bucket.
S3 Folder URL: The URL associated with your connected S3 bucket.
HTTP Headers: Optional strings that add metadata to the Amazon S3 REST request:
Key: The case-sensitive name of the HTTP header.
Value: The parameters for the HTTP header.
Edit limits for Traffic Capture Essentials:
Storage Limit: The maximum amount of data to be kept in the file when a policy configured for Traffic Capture Essentials triggers.
Sampling: The percentage of traffic that is sampled for capturing when Traffic Capture Essentials is triggered.
Obfuscate information in Traffic Capture Essentials data:
Usernames: Choose whether usernames are Visible or Obfuscated in created PCAP files.
Devices: Choose whether device information is Visible or Obfuscated in created PCAP files.
Go to the Traffic Capture tab. To learn more, see Configuring Settings for the Traffic Capture Policy.
